item.description: A near-year-long freighter slot suspension at Mumbai International Airport (MIAL), from August until May 2027, has again drawn flak from IATA.. item.title: Hyundai brings in AI for vehicle loading onto PCTCs
item.description: Hyundai Glovis, Hyundai Motor’s shipping arm, is to use artificial intelligence to determine how vehicles are loaded on its pure car and truck carriers (PCTCs). A proprietary in-house-developed system will calculate the optimal loading location by considering port call order, cargo weight, and height.
